header.label: Our Mission
header.title:
Theatre as a Tool
for Social Change
header.subtitle: We believe every play has the power to change a mind, and every changed mind has the power to transform a community. Our work goes beyond the stage.

cards.title: Gender Justice & Women's Rights
cards.description: Productions like Mera Kya Kasoor — which won national acclaim at Rajrangam — tackle female foeticide, gender discrimination, and the plight of the girl child. Our plays have reached schools, rural communities, and urban audiences alike.

cards.title: Cultural Heritage & Identity
cards.description: We work with Classical, Traditional and Modern Art Forms of Theatre. Regularly Performing Social Awareness, Contemporary, Comedy Stage Plays, Nukkad Natak, Musical Plays etc.

cards.title: Civic Awareness & Democracy
cards.description: From celebrating India's freedom struggle to staging plays about political accountability and voter rights, ATR takes theatre into the heart of civic discourse, making complex issues accessible to all.

cards.title: Youth Empowerment
cards.description: Through the Actors Academy of Rajasthan, we train young artists in voice, movement, direction, and dramaturgy — giving them tools not just for performance, but for life and leadership.
